# Gal Disegni

> Original hand-painted art, portraits, art prints, and visionary-art workshops by Israeli artist Gal Disegni, based in Hadera, Israel. Site is bilingual: English (default, root URLs) and Hebrew (/he/ prefix).

Gal Disegni creates original paintings and portraits (realistic, intuitive, and visionary styles - completely original, no AI), sells fine art prints and apparel of his artwork, takes private commissions, and runs in-person and ongoing art workshops.

## Shop
- [All Prints](https://disegni.studio/collections/prints/): fine art paper, stretched canvas, and framed prints of original artworks, made to order
- [Available Originals](https://disegni.studio/collections/originals/): one-of-a-kind original paintings currently for sale
- [Apparel](https://disegni.studio/collections/apparel/): hoodies, t-shirts, and other clothing featuring original artwork
- [Stickers](https://disegni.studio/collections/stickers/)
- [Gallery / all artworks](https://disegni.studio/)

## Commissions
- [Commissions](https://disegni.studio/commissions/): custom personal portraits and paintings, private inquiry process, multiple tiers and price points

## Workshops
- [All Workshops](https://disegni.studio/workshops/): visionary-art painting workshops, in Hadera, Israel and ongoing/online formats
- [Daily Art Workshop](https://disegni.studio/workshops/daily-art/)
- [Ongoing Workshop](https://disegni.studio/workshops/monthly-art/)
- [8-Session Track](https://disegni.studio/workshops/structured-art/)

## Notes
- All artwork is genuinely hand-made by Gal Disegni - no AI-generated art.
- Prices are shown in ILS (₪); international shipping available, shipping cost calculated by size/quantity at checkout.
- Hebrew version of every page above is available at the same path under /he/ (e.g. https://disegni.studio/he/commissions/).
